description: SCATS detector -> approach map for the sites used in counts.parquet. One row per counted vehicle stop-line detector. Read from our own downloaded copy of the DTP Traffic Signal Configuration Data Sheets (CC BY 4.0; data/SOURCES.md) under George's approved exception (CLAUDE.md constraint 1, 2026-10-27). heading = direction of travel of the approaching traffic. approach_coverage: 'full' = every general-traffic lane of the approach has its own stop-line loop; 'partial' = a single diagonal loop spans several lanes, or a lane has no loop (such approaches are NOT written to counts.parquet). Detectors not listed (bicycle, tram, bus, queue, advance, hook-turn box, pushbutton, transfer-of-demand, not used) are summarised per site in other_detectors and never counted.
detector_numbering: NB_DETECTOR in the volume CSVs equals the detector number on the sheet (checked: e.g. at 2902 the pushbuttons 16-19 read zero and the bicycle loops 1,4 read ~100-700/day; at 2924, a 32-row site, the bicycle loops 1,3,5,7,11 read ~700-1,300/day and the lane loops 4,6,8 ~6,000).

source_values.data_engineer_read: read by the data engineer from our own sheet copy (George's AI output absent or disagreeing)
source_values.george_ai_verified: George's AI first pass (~/Downloads/signal_sheets, a derived reference) gave the same type, street and direction, and the data engineer confirmed it on our own sheet copy

recheck_10pct.method: random.Random(20261027).sample of the mapped sites, 10% rounded (5 of 47); each detector map re-read at full resolution from our own sheet copy and compared detector by detector with the first reading

corrected.finding: Russell St NB and SB each have a left-turn lane with no loop; first reading had both approaches as full coverage
corrected.fix: approaches 4595-3 and 4595-4 set to partial (not written to counts.parquet)

recheck_10pct.result: 4 of 5 confirmed, 1 corrected (coverage error, not a direction or detector-number error)
